cues.zh: 周日晚上。三个截止日期。零计划。
cues.line_text: Sunday night. Three deadlines. Zero plan.
Sunday night. Three deadlines. Zero plan.
Sunday night. Three deadlines. Zero plan.

cues.zh: 一篇论文。两章要读。周五还有小测。
cues.line_text: An essay. Two chapters to read. And a quiz on Friday.
An essay. Two chapters to read. And a quiz on Friday.
An essay. Two chapters to read. And a quiz on Friday.

cues.text: So you open your laptop, and somehow, an hour of scrolling later, nothing has started.
cues.zh: 于是你打开电脑，不知怎么刷了一小时，什么都没开始。
cues.line_text: So you open your laptop, and somehow, an hour of scrolling later, nothing has started.

cues.zh: 问题通常不在你，而是这个任务大到无从下手。
cues.line_text: The problem usually isn't you. The task is just too big to start.

cues.text: The task is just too big to start.
cues.line_text: The problem usually isn't you. The task is just too big to start.

cues.text: In the next three minutes, let's turn that mess into a plan for your week.
cues.zh: 接下来三分钟，我们把这团乱麻变成一周计划。
cues.line_text: In the next three minutes, let's turn that mess into a plan for your week.

cues.zh: 三个动作：拆碎、排进、核对。
cues.line_text: Three moves. Smash it. Slot it. Check it.
Three moves. Smash it. Slot it. Check it.
Three moves. Smash it. Slot it. Check it.
Three moves. Smash it. Slot it. Check it.

cues.text: And stay until the end, because there's one slot most plans forget to leave empty.
cues.zh: 坚持看到最后，因为有一个空档大多数计划都忘了留。
cues.line_text: And stay until the end, because there's one slot most plans forget to leave empty.

cues.zh: 第一步：拆碎。
cues.line_text: Move one. Smash it.
Move one. Smash it.

cues.zh: 拿出最大的任务：写论文。
cues.line_text: Take the biggest task. Write the essay.
Take the biggest task. Write the essay.

cues.text: You can't finish that in one sitting.
cues.zh: 你没法一次坐下来写完，所以把它拆开。
cues.line_text: You can't finish that in one sitting. So break it.
You can't finish that in one sitting. So break it.

cues.zh: 选题。
cues.line_text: Choose a topic.

cues.zh: 找三份资料。
cues.line_text: Find three sources.

cues.zh: 写提纲。
cues.line_text: Write an outline.

cues.zh: 写引言初稿。
cues.line_text: Draft the intro.

cues.zh: 写正文初稿。
cues.line_text: Draft the body.

cues.zh: 修改并提交。
cues.line_text: Edit and submit.

cues.zh: 六块。每块都以动词开头，每块都有明确的终点。
cues.line_text: Six pieces. Each one starts with a verb, and each one has a clear finish line.

cues.text: Each one starts with a verb, and each one has a clear finish line.
cues.line_text: Six pieces. Each one starts with a verb, and each one has a clear finish line.

cues.zh: 快速测试：你能在五分钟内开始吗？不能就再拆。
cues.line_text: Quick test. Could you start it in the next five minutes? If not, smash it again.

cues.text: Could you start it in the next five minutes?
cues.line_text: Quick test. Could you start it in the next five minutes? If not, smash it again.
Quick test. Could you start it in the next five minutes? If not, smash it again.

cues.text: Now the reading and the quiz.
cues.zh: 再拆阅读和小测，又是四块。
cues.line_text: Now the reading and the quiz. Four more pieces.
Now the reading and the quiz. Four more pieces.

cues.text: Three scary tasks just became ten small ones.
cues.zh: 三个吓人的任务变成了十个小块。
cues.line_text: Three scary tasks just became ten small ones.

cues.zh: 第二步：排进。
cues.line_text: Move two. Slot it.
Move two. Slot it.

cues.zh: 这是你的一周，但先别填。
cues.line_text: Here's your week. But don't fill it yet.
Here's your week. But don't fill it yet.

cues.text: First, block out what's already taken.
cues.zh: 先把已占用的时间划掉：上课、工作、吃饭、休息。
cues.line_text: First, block out what's already taken. Classes. Work. Meals. Rest.
First, block out what's already taken. Classes. Work. Meals. Rest.
First, block out what's already taken. Classes. Work. Meals. Rest.
First, block out what's already taken. Classes. Work. Meals. Rest.
First, block out what's already taken. Classes. Work. Meals. Rest.

cues.text: What's left is your real study time.
cues.zh: 剩下的才是真正的学习时间。在这个示例里，工作日晚上约一小时，周六更多。
cues.line_text: What's left is your real study time. In this example, about an hour on weeknights, and more on Saturday.

cues.text: In this example, about an hour on weeknights, and more on Saturday.
cues.line_text: What's left is your real study time. In this example, about an hour on weeknights, and more on Saturday.

cues.text: Your week will look different, and that's fine.
cues.zh: 你的一周会不一样，这没关系。
cues.line_text: Your week will look different, and that's fine.

cues.zh: 截止日期优先。小测在周五，所以阅读排在前面。
cues.line_text: Deadlines go first. The quiz is on Friday, so the reading lands early.

cues.text: The quiz is on Friday, so the reading lands early.
cues.line_text: Deadlines go first. The quiz is on Friday, so the reading lands early.

cues.text: The essay pieces fill the gaps.
cues.zh: 论文的小块填进空隙。
cues.line_text: The essay pieces fill the gaps.

cues.text: And remember that slot I mentioned?
cues.zh: 还记得我说的那个空档吗？就在这里。
cues.line_text: And remember that slot I mentioned? Here it is.
And remember that slot I mentioned? Here it is.

cues.zh: 故意留一个空档。
cues.line_text: Leave one slot empty. On purpose.
Leave one slot empty. On purpose.

cues.text: Because something usually takes longer than you expect.
cues.zh: 因为总有事情比预想的更久。
cues.line_text: Because something usually takes longer than you expect.

cues.zh: 第三步：核对。
cues.line_text: Move three. Check it.
Move three. Check it.

cues.text: Every night, take two minutes and tick off what's done.
cues.zh: 每天晚上花两分钟，勾掉完成的事。
cues.line_text: Every night, take two minutes and tick off what's done.

cues.zh: 周一，完成。周二，完成。
cues.line_text: Monday. Done. Tuesday. Done.
Monday. Done. Tuesday. Done.
Monday. Done. Tuesday. Done.
Monday. Done. Tuesday. Done.

cues.zh: 周三，提纲超时了。
cues.line_text: Wednesday. The outline ran long.
Wednesday. The outline ran long.

cues.zh: 别慌，空档就是为这个准备的。
cues.line_text: No panic. That's what the empty slot is for.

cues.text: That's what the empty slot is for.
cues.line_text: No panic. That's what the empty slot is for.

cues.zh: 把它挪到周六。计划会弯，但不会断。
cues.line_text: Move it to Saturday. The plan bends instead of breaking.

cues.text: The plan bends instead of breaking.
cues.line_text: Move it to Saturday. The plan bends instead of breaking.

cues.text: And if a piece keeps slipping, it's still too big.
cues.zh: 如果某块一再拖延，说明它还太大，再拆一次。
cues.line_text: And if a piece keeps slipping, it's still too big. Smash it again.
And if a piece keeps slipping, it's still too big. Smash it again.

cues.text: At the end of the week, ask two questions.
cues.zh: 周末问自己两个问题。
cues.line_text: At the end of the week, ask two questions.

cues.zh: 什么有效？下周我要改什么？
cues.line_text: What worked? And what will I change next week?

cues.text: And what will I change next week?
cues.line_text: What worked? And what will I change next week?

cues.zh: 这就是整个方法：拆碎、排进、核对。
cues.line_text: So that's the whole method. Smash it. Slot it. Check it.
So that's the whole method. Smash it. Slot it. Check it.

cues.text: You don't need a perfect plan.
cues.zh: 你不需要完美的计划，你需要一个真的会开始的计划。
cues.line_text: You don't need a perfect plan. You need one you'll actually start.

cues.text: You need one you'll actually start.
cues.line_text: You don't need a perfect plan. You need one you'll actually start.

cues.text: Pick one task tonight, and smash it into pieces.
cues.zh: 今晚挑一个任务，把它拆碎。
cues.line_text: Pick one task tonight, and smash it into pieces.

cues.zh: 感谢观看。
cues.line_text: Thanks for watching.
